nisi cum Filius hominis a mortuis resurrexerit.

Quisquis unum ex hujusmodi pueris receperit in nomine meo,
“Whoever receives one such child in my name,
John responded to him by saying,
vidimus quemdam in nomine tuo ejicientem dæmonia,
we saw someone casting out demons in your name;
nemo est enim qui faciat virtutem in nomine meo,
For there is no one who can act with virtue in my name
et possit cito male loqui de me:
and soon speak evil about me.
qui enim non est adversum vos, pro vobis est.
For whoever is not against you is for you.
Quisquis enim potum dederit vobis calicem aquæ in nomine meo,
For whoever, in my name, will give you a cup of water to drink,
he shall not lose his reward.
Et quisquis scandalizaverit unum ex his pusillis credentibus in me:
And whoever will have scandalized one of these little ones who believe in me:
bonum est ei magis si circumdaretur mola asinaria collo ejus,
it would be better for him if a great millstone were placed around his neck
and he were thrown into the sea.
Et si scandalizaverit te manus tua,
And if your hand causes you to sin,
bonum est tibi debilem introire in vitam,
it is better for you to enter into life disabled,
quam duas manus habentem ire in gehennam,
than having two hands to go into Hell,
where their worm does not die,
and the fire is not extinguished.
Et si pes tuus te scandalizat,
But if your foot causes you to sin,
bonum est tibi claudum introire in vitam æternam,
it is better for you to enter into eternal life lame,
quam duos pedes habentem mitti in gehennam ignis inextinguibilis,
than having two feet to be cast into the Hell of unquenchable fire,
where their worm does not die,
and the fire is not extinguished.
Quod si oculus tuus scandalizat te,
But if your eye causes you to sin,
bonum est tibi luscum introire in regnum Dei,
it is better for you to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye,
quam duos oculos habentem mitti in gehennam ignis,
than having two eyes to be cast into the Hell of fire,
where their worm does not die,
and the fire is not extinguished.
For all shall be salted with fire,
and every victim shall be salted with salt.
but if the salt has become bland,
with what will you season it?
